title: Prepare release cannot open the release PR: Actions may not create pull requests
description: Prepare release on 26d45f9 (merge of PR #2) pushed the release branch with 0.0.1 but failed creating the PR: 403 'GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests.' The repository setting Settings → Actions → General → 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' is off (can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false). Enable it (gh api -X PUT repos/markmals/mcp/actions/permissions/workflow -f default_workflow_permissions=read -F can_approve_pull_request_reviews=true) or give Knope a token that may; then rerun Prepare release. The agent-cli template's README does not mention this setup step; mela2sql and recon have the same setting off.

title: Build archives fail on a private repository: attestations need a public repo
description: actions/attest-build-provenance fails with 'Feature not available for user-owned private repositories' (run 45074661443, x86_64-apple-darwin). While markmals/mcp is private, Build archives and therefore release.yml cannot finish. Decide: make the repo public before the first release, or skip attestation for private repositories (and say so in README).
